This FloPlast push-fit 135° single socket bottom offset bend is an essential uPVC component for soil and vent drainage systems, designed to redirect wastewater efficiently. Its robust construction is ideal for various plumbing installations, including connecting soil pipes in tight spaces. The lightweight, durable uPVC material ensures long-lasting performance and easy handling on site. Featuring a secure push-fit connection with reliable ring seal joints, installation is straightforward, especially when using silicone lubricant. This black 110mm offset bend also handles high temperature waste discharges, providing a versatile and dependable solution for professional plumbers.
